{{Quote|You were right, Skywalker. I ''am'' a slave...just as you are.|Miraj Scintel, to Anakin Skywalker as she dies|<ref name="EFK" />}}
'''Miraj Scintel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Queen/Legends|queen]] who was the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In an attempt to reestablish Zygerria's prominence as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|empire]], Scintel made a bid to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. She enslaved the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].

==Biography==

===Early life===
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]],<ref name="SOTR" /> Miraj Scintel took the throne of [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] by the times of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name=":2">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref> Queen Miraj ruled from a royal palace guarded by fortress walls, which sat atop a lofty mesa.<ref name=":0">{{SWE|characters|queenmirajscintel|Queen Miraj Scintel}}</ref> She used [[Brezak/Legends|brezaks]] for flight from her lofty residence<ref name="SOTR" /> to the lower market levels of her walled city.<ref name="SWE-brezak">{{SWE|characters|brezak|brezak}}</ref> She had never seen any [[Human/Legends|man]] withstanding the power of five [[Shock whip|whips]].<ref name=":3" />

Miraj Scintel longed for a return to glory for her [[Zygerrian/Legends|people]]<ref name=":0" /> and the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]].<ref name="SOTR" />

===Attempt reborn of the Slave Empire===
As the Confederacy gained momentum<ref name="SOTR" /> and taking advantage of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] distracted by war,<ref name=":0" /> Queen Scintel saw an opportunity to reestablish Zygerria's ancient [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|empire]] and concocted a plot to gain allegiance with Separatist leader [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]],<ref name="SOTR" /> becoming a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]].<ref name=":4" /> Dispatching [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] to the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colony world of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], Scintel ordered him to capture the colonists and return them to Zygerria so they could be sold to Dooku at auction.<ref name="SOTR" />

[[File:AnakinSavesMiraj-SotR.jpg|thumb|left|250x250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] saves the queen from an assassination attempt.]]

Following the [[Battle of Kiros|invasion]] of Kiros and the transfer of the slaves to a processing plant on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]], a group of Jedi infiltrated Zygerria and Scintel's [[Royal Palace of Zygerria/Legends|palace]]. Posing as a slaver named Lars Quell, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] proposed to sell his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was also disguised as a Togruta slave, to Scintel.<ref name="SOTR" /> Though she didn't wholly believe Anakin's story, she was nonetheless intrigued by him.<ref name=":0" /> She accepted the slave and requested "Quell" remain at her side for a time. During their walk about the palace, a [[Unidentified Twi'lek girl (Zygerria)/Legends|young slave girl]] attempted to assassinate the queen, only to be stopped by Skywalker,<ref name="SOTR" /> stopping the would-be regicide.<ref name=":5">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep412|text="Slaves of the Republic" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girl, fearful of remaining a slave and being punished, leaped from the ramparts to her death. While [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] infiltrated the nearby slave pits, Jedi Skywalker continued to warm up to Scintel in hopes of discovering the locations of the missing Kiros slaves.<ref name="SOTR" />

Accompanying Scintel to the auction house, Skywalker witnessed the brutality of Scintel's empire when Master Kenobi, whose cover was blown earlier in the slave pits, was ordered to be beaten on the bidding floor. Scintel ordered Skywalker to show his loyalty to her through beating the Jedi and was shocked when Skywalker revealed his identity as a Jedi. As his comrades leaped to defend him from the throng of guards, Padawan Tano attacked Scintel; the queen had already had the Jedi girl's neck fitted with a shock collar and simply activated it to render her inert. With Tano unconscious and the Jedi subdued, Scintel ordered Skywalker to be taken back to her chambers in the palace and the others separated and imprisoned as slaves.<ref name="SOTR" /> The next day,<ref name=":5" /> Scintel waited for Skywalker to wake in her chambers, offering him an appointment as her personal bodyguard. While the Jedi resisted at first, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] strangle her, Scintel persuaded him by threatening to have his friends executed should she die. During their time together, Scintel began to drift closer to Skywalker, deducing that he was once a slave before he became a Jedi.<ref name="SOTR" /> She saw in Anakin a prize to own and overpower, and used her seductive charms to her full advantage.<ref name=":0" /> Despite her efforts to convince the Jedi to see the galaxy as she saw it, Skywalker rebuffed all her flirtatious advances even when she offered to free his friends if he swore fealty to her.<ref name="SOTR" />

Scintel's affections for Skywalker did not go unnoticed; [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]] feared the queen had been weakened by the Jedi and contacted Count Dooku to rectify the problem. Upon Dooku's arrival, Scintel confiscated Skywalker's lightsaber and dismissed him from her court. Scintel received Dooku in her throne room and detailed her plot to enslave the Jedi as she did Kenobi and Skywalker, crushing the Order and then the Republic. Dooku deemed her plan too ambitious, made it plain he was only interested in eradicating the Jedi Order, not enslaving it, and&mdash;seeing through her thinly veiled emotions for Skywalker&mdash;demanded that he be disposed of.<ref name="EFK" />

===Death===
[[File:MirajScintelChoked-EFK.png|thumb|250x250px|Scintel [[Telekinesis/Legends|strangled]] through the Force by Count Dooku]]

Infuriated by Dooku's brash statements and Minister Molec's betrayal, Scintel revealed an [[Shock whip|electro-whip]] clipped to her belt and attempted to attack the Count, but was quickly disarmed and throttled with the Force. As she struggled to breathe against the Count's hold, Skywalker burst into the chamber and, unconcerned by the Count's threat to kill her unless he surrendered, attacked Dooku with the electro-whip, but was quickly disarmed.<ref name="EFK" />

No match against Dooku without a weapon, Skywalker was surrounded by palace guards but managed to abscond from the chamber with the queen before being felled. Fleeing the palace and boarding the ship he arrived in, the [[Tecora/Legends|''Tecora'']], Skywalker and his freed Padawan Tano prepared to take off in search of Kenobi and the Togruta colonists.<ref name="EFK" /> Beaten,<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> the dying queen revealed the location of the slaves before succumbing to her injuries. With her last breath, she acknowledged that she had become a slave just like Skywalker himself.<ref name="EFK" />

===Legacy===
After her death, her [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]] ascended to the throne as the king.<ref name="Friends Like These">''[[Friends Like These]]''</ref>

Scintel's last words<ref name="EFK" /> ended up becaming prophetic when,<ref name=":1">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[19 BBY/Legends|the following year]],<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] joined [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and became a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], essentially a slave.<ref name=":1" /> Now going under the title of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], he became a slaver himself after the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] had been ordered by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to sell [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] women and children into a slave market at [[Orvax IV]]. He learned of this during a debriefing for the [[Cleansing of New Plympto]] when Commander [[Vill]] let slip about the Emperor's order. Vader grew despondent enough at the revelation as a result that he abruptly ended his presence at the debriefing and could not fall asleep that night, due to remembering his own time as a slave.<ref name="Dark Times 2">[[Dark Times 2|''Dark Times'' 2]]</ref> He later revealed what he had learned to the Emperor, and ultimately let it continue despite his misgivings after the Emperor told him the Imperial way was "different."<ref name="Dark Times 3">[[Dark Times 3|''Dark Times'' 3]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:MirajPetBirds-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|Queen Miraj with pet birds from Kiros]]
Miraj Scintel was a typical [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]]: she strongly believed the natural order was for the strong to dominate the weak. She was extremely proud of her people's ways and relished her status as queen. Although she knew most others saw the Zygerrians traditions of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] primitive, Scintel believed that slavery brought purpose to those with an innate desire to serve.<ref name="SOTR" /> She possessed an outward beauty that concealed a darkness within.<ref name=":0" /> Like most of her race, she was ruthless and had no qualms about using brutal and malicious methods to achieve her goals. She treated her personal slaves with cruelty and made a point of showing them their place; such was her treatment that one even committed suicide after a failed attempt to kill her.<ref name="EFK" />

Due to her Zygerrian nature and royal status, Scintel was extremely arrogant, believing that any person could be brought to submission with the proper methods and tools. Thus she did not enjoy being given orders from anyone and was firm in making her own decisions. Ultimately, this trait proved to be her undoing, when she made Anakin Skywalker her slave and imprisoned his friends despite Count Dooku ordering her to kill them and warning her of the consequences, an order the queen angrily ignored, causing the Count to kill Scintel for her defiance. However, she was not an entirely cruel person, as she revealed the locations of Togruta slaves before she expired. Despite being Zygerrian, she was able to realize the folly of slavery when betrayed by Dooku and Atai Molec and acknowledged this to Anakin.<ref name="EFK" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ZygerrianQueen.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Scintel, as she appeared in the comic version of ''Slaves of the Republic'']]Miraj Scintel first appeared in the [[The Clone Wars 3|third issue]] of the [[Dark Horse Comics]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic]]'',<ref name="The Clone Wars 3">[[The Clone Wars 3|''The Clone Wars'' 3]]</ref> published in [[December 10]], [[2008]].<ref name="Date">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/15-681/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-3|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #3}}</ref> While first mentioned in the [[The Clone Wars 2|second issue]],<ref name="The Clone Wars 2">[[The Clone Wars 2|''The Clone Wars'' 2]]</ref> she was first identied as Miraj in the [[The Clone Wars 4|fourth issue]]<ref name=":3">[[The Clone Wars 4|''The Clone Wars'' 4]]</ref> and her last name was revealed in the [[The Clone Wars 5|fifth one]].<ref name=":4">[[The Clone Wars 5|''The Clone Wars'' 5]]</ref> The story arc was later adapted for screen by the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, spanning the episodes "[[Kidnapped]],"<ref name=":2" /> "[[Slaves of the Republic]],"<ref name="SOTR" /> and "[[Escape from Kadavo]]."<ref name="EFK" /> The televised episodes effectively supplanted the comic series' former place in [[canon]].<ref name="Chee Facebook">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|name=Leland Chee|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=295828993771367&id=201820953172172|nobackup=1}}</ref> She was voiced by [[Rajia Baroudi]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="SOTR" /> The episodes followed the same premise as the comics but featured a number of differences, most notably a visual redesign for the Zygerrians. [[Dave Filoni]] decided to give the Zygerrians,<ref name="Complete Season 4">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four|featurette=The Slaves of Zygerria}}</ref> including their queen Scintel,<ref name="SOTR" /> a more [[Wikipedia:coyote|coyote]]-like appearance, believing that the mythological character [[Wikipedia:Coyote (mythology)|Coyote's]] reputation as a trickster would make the species look more deceitful.<ref name="Complete Season 4" />
